name: context-handoff
description: At a set share of context used, lock the session to a Solo handoff and successor spawn, so long sessions stop re-sending huge histories.

threshold.title: Context threshold (%)
threshold.description: Share of the context window used at which the session locks and hands off. It is a share of the model's window: on a 1M-token window, 50 is about 500k tokens.

skill.title: Handoff skill
skill.description: Skill the session runs to hand off, without its slash. The default is the solo-handoff skill this plugin ships, which writes the handoff and spawns a successor in Solo; name your own to replace it.
